extractor_notes.blockers: Large-pharma Q1 2026 6-K is financial-heavy. All Phase III readouts (EMERALD-3, OBERON/TITANIA/MIRANDA, ATHLOS, MULBERRY/CHESTNUT, I CAN, SAMETA) and regulatory approvals listed are historical Q1 2026 events. Forward language is generic ('further readouts anticipated this year') without specific trial-by-trial dates. Subsequent May 2026 6-Ks (Truqap ODAC, camizestrant ODAC, VOLGA) are also historical event reports. No specific forward-looking clinical dates with day/month/quarter precision in earnings PR.
extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier0 likely captures the same pipeline; no Tier1 sharpening available from earnings PR forward statements.
